name: Artorius Diondale
original_name: アルトリウス・ディオンデール
source:
Commander of the knights of the Kingdom of Fordgilia.
He is also the father of [url=/c123046]Adelaite Diondale[/url] and a national hero who played an active part in the latest great war. Due to his diligent personality, he mercilessly forces his daughter to take on the most dangerous tasks.
translation:
Commander of the knights of the Kingdom of Fordgilia.
